svg.title: How a CPU is integrated in a LiteX SoC
svg.desc: A CPU in a LiteX SoC. The wrapper (litex/soc/cores/cpu/<name>/core.py) instantiates the core (Verilog, VHDL, SpinalHDL, Chisel or Amaranth sources, from a pythondata package or generated at build time) and exposes it to the SoC builder: the peripheral buses become masters of the main bus through adapters, the memory buses go straight to the LiteDRAM crossbar, the DMA bus is a coherent slave port for the DMAs, the interrupt lines come from the IRQ handler, the reset from the SoC controller, the reset address from the ROM origin. The wrapper also gives the memory map constraints (io_regions, mem_map) to the SoC builder and the compiler flags, crt0.S and irq.h to the Builder for the BIOS and the firmware.
